title: Open a Buddy DM inside the Channels view
summary: Owner's ask was to open a Buddy DM in the Slack-style Channels view rather than navigate to the conversation view. The implementation landed and is integrated; no unresolved part of that ask remains. Separate channel-DM composer work is tracked in review and should not be conflated with this request.
nextAction: No follow-up needed for the original ask. Keep the distinct thread-style DM composer/send task in review with its owner.
evidence: Thread reply reports working desktop/phone DM-in-Channels behavior, URL persistence, Back behavior, click-through verification, typecheck and 157 client tests on commit c5e4f91.
Read-only git check: c5e4f91 is an ancestor of current HEAD; commit contains ChannelBrowser, Chat, ChannelsMobile and channel-buddy-dm test changes.

Current task buddy_project_e9c63dc5-54aa-43f6-ba72-9ee33a7f16d8 is done; its evidence records live POST timings 2.3ms/1.0ms/1.0ms versus prior 27.7s, and owner test that clicking a Buddy opened the DM fast. Root ask did not require latency profiling.

Separate task buddy_project_a978f8e4-6566-434d-aa9d-2667269da30e remains review; evidence reports desktop and 390px phone channel-DM presentation and client checks. Its richer composer/send acceptance is separate from the root ask.
limitations: No tests or runtime interaction were performed in this review. Commit ancestry and source were checked read-only; current live release state was not independently verified.
